notes.title: The physical version of The Cub for Nintendo Switch is out now!
notes.notes:
[i]Greetings, travellers of the abandoned Earth! [/i] We’re thrilled to share that we discovered some [b]treasures[/b] [i]from before GEC[/i] among the ruins. It’s a supply of shiny and content-packed physical versions of [b]The Cub Back To Earth Edition[/b] for [b]Nintendo Switch[/b]!

However, first things first: we wanted to take a moment to [b]thank you for your continued support on Steam.[/b] It’s a special moment for us; [b]we couldn’t have done it without you[/b]. 

[hr][/hr]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42160742/d2dbe064e04535ef7026f00836b2aeea7ddd650d.png[/img]

[h3][b]Going back to the subject, what can you expect from Back To Earth Edition?[/b]
[/h3]
🎮 Full game on cartridge
🖼️ An artbook that will take you on a creative journey among the changed surface of our home planet
📼 Digital version of the game’s soundtrack full of mysticism and mystery intertwined with nostalgia

Whether you’re double-dipping, have always wanted to play [b]The Cub[/b] on a handheld, or have shared the adventure with your friend, thank you for being part of the journey.

🌎 Get Back To Earth Edition here:
https://meridiem-games.com/en/game/the-cub


[hr][/hr]

[h3]About The Cub[/h3]

From the creators of Golf Club Nostalgia and Highwater. Return to their whimsical, neon-lit apocalypse in a Jungle Book meets The Armageddon fusion. Parkour through the remains of humanity as a child being hunted, while catchy end-of-days tunes and curious survivor stories play on the radio.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1941410/The_Cub/

Your captivating journey into the neon-lit apocalypse with The Cub, the latest creation from the masterminds behind Golf Club Nostalgia and Highwater starts soon!

The Cub comes to PC, PlayStation, and Nintendo Switch on January 19th 2024!
